description: The ultrapower of the natural-number arithmetic structure interprets zero, successor, addition and multiplication coordinatewise on sequence classes.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.Ultraproducts.Arithmetic.coordinate_operations (U : Ultrafilter ℕ) :
  (Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue (Lemmatheca.Entry.Ultraproducts.Arithmetic.Power U) =
      Quotient.mk' fun x => 0) ∧
    (∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ),
        Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.succValue (Lemmatheca.Entry.Ultraproducts.Arithmetic.Power U)
            (Quotient.mk' f) =
          Quotient.mk' fun n => f n + 1) ∧
      (∀ (f g : ℕ → ℕ),
          Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.addValue (Lemmatheca.Entry.Ultraproducts.Arithmetic.Power U)
              (Quotient.mk' f) (Quotient.mk' g) =
            Quotient.mk' fun n => f n + g n) ∧
        ∀ (f g : ℕ → ℕ),
          Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.mulValue (Lemmatheca.Entry.Ultraproducts.Arithmetic.Power U)
              (Quotient.mk' f) (Quotient.mk' g) =
            Quotient.mk' fun n => f n * g n
